dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: If it's something you believe in, just do it! That's our mindset here at the Collective of Plenty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Hello there, friend from afar!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Judging by your expression, this must be your first time here, so welcome! I'm Acatl, chief of the Collective of Plenty.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: No need to feel on edge. We're not too concerned with formalities here — all that matters is courage, perseverance, and the strength of will never to back down in the ring.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Here at the Collective of Plenty, we show all valiant warriors and dear friends the respect they deserve. May your stay be a pleasant one.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey there.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Aha, we meet again! Welcome to the Collective of Plenty, my friend!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: How's everything been going? Still as happy and well-fed as always?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Now that you're here, it's time to sit back and enjoy a bit of signature Collective of Plenty-style hospitality! C'mon, make yourself at home!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your mask...

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Oh, you're interested in our masks?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: It's a time-honored wrestling tradition. The loser must remove their mask, while the victor keeps theirs on, retaining a sense of mystery that inspires others to step up and challenge them.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: As for mine... I've never once been forced to remove it, whether I was facing a human or a saurian.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Safe travels, friend!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But... What if someone else tried to pass themselves off as chief?

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Haha, a few of our young-uns have asked me the same thing. "If you're always wearing a mask, Chief, how would we even know you're not an imposter?"

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: The answer's simple — if you doubt who I am, come face me in the ring.

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Words can deceive, writing can mislead, but muscles... never lie.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't mind if I do!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Haha, no wonder they call you the hero of "hope." Our young lads and lasses from the Collective could learn a thing or two from your bold spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Acatl
dialogues.text: Now, prepare to witness the power of fine dining, Collective of Plenty style!
